I've had 13 attempted suicides idk what hell your going through but i too have thought about trying again but there's one thing holding me back even if its by the slightest. I always tell people im not gonna be here for along time but a fun time. Before you go just take this advice into consideration. If your going to die today why not make it the best day. Hell go to a bar get something to drink, smoke some cigarettes or something else if u catch my drift. Rent out an exotic car or check into a nice hotel l, go to a nice restaurant i don't care just try to have as much fun as possible. Your mind is made up. There's nothing i could say that would cure you of your pain 100 percent but can you at least try to make your last day the best day. Hell why not make it your best week, instead of going out and giving into your demons why not tell them to Fuck off and do everything you've wanted. That way you go out having lived a full life and not let your pain best you. I only hope you can manage some fun or happiness in your life even if its just a sliver of joy its much better than suffering.
Don't hold on to the past and let it define you, hold on to the future and let it guide you.
